resources.string:
Allow music and audio access in system settings, then tap Scan local music.

If copied songs are still missing, use the system Files app to copy them into Music, wait for Android to index them, then scan again. Also check hidden artists, albums and folders.

Each scan checks up to 1,000 recent audio files accessible to this app and refreshes the library. Refresh inside a playlist updates its library view.
Asking Android to index accessible audio…
Allow music and audio access in system settings, then try again. Saved playlists are kept.
Could not scan accessible audio. Check access and try again; saved playlists are kept.
The indexing request ended, but the music library could not be read. Check access and try again.
Android did not finish indexing in time. Some files may still be processing. Try again after the system finishes.
No accessible audio files to scan. Library refreshed. See Missing songs? for help.
Scanned %1$d of %2$d audio files. Some entries were skipped or the 1,000-file limit was reached. See Missing songs? for help.
Scanned %1$d audio files. Music library refreshed.
